title: Politics chat: The polls show a Democratic sweep in the midterms. Can you trust them?
description: If you look at the few truly competitive seats, polls show a more complicated picture of momentum toward the Democratic Party in midterm House races. For the Senate, Republicans are on defense.

title: Democrats see an opportunity to tilt Pennsylvania's state legislature their way
description: Statehouse elections this fall could swing the balance of power in state capitals. In Pennsylvania, Democrats could take control of what has been a divided legislature.

title: Independent candidates sense a moment in the West. Democrats are hoping they're right
description: As they look to win the Senate, Democrats are hoping that independent candidates in Nebraska and Montana can help them topple Republicans in a part of the country where their own brand is hurting.

title: In Arkansas, Democrats see an opening at the edge of the competitive midterms map
description: In a sign of the potentially dire midterm political environment, Republicans have spent millions of dollars playing defense in Arkansas, one of the most conservative states in the country.

title: The rise of the economic populist: What voters want from both parties this year
description: A new kind of economic populism is surging in both parties this year as voters search for a political party that can solve growing concerns about financial stability.

title: Week in Politics: Ramaswamy's Ohio ad; Trump greenlights DOJ to sue over Alaska Senate
description: Ohio GOP gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy refuses to withdrawal an explosive attack ad, and President Trump greenlights the DOJ to file a lawsuit about Alaska's senate race.

title: This decade has been missing its big-impact midterm
description: Every other decade over the past hundred years has produced at least one midterm that made a big difference in Congress and in national politics more broadly.

title: At a Texas high school football game, fans offer a glimpse into evolving politics
description: We talk with voters at a Texas high school football game at the tailgate, in line at the concession booth and in the stands to hear about the issues that matter to Texans this cycle.

title: Russia steps up election influence efforts in final stretch of midterms
description: Researchers who track online influence operations say Kremlin-backed groups are renewing tactics they've used to sow distrust and discord in previous elections in the U.S. and around the world.

title: The Pentagon's guidelines for "responsible AI" aren't always followed, report shows
description: The Pentagon is building weapons and projects with AI capabilities that officials say don't always closely adhere to the agency's own guidelines for AI, according to a congressional watchdog report published in October.
